I have many contacts in the security industry. There is one man I have known for a good few years after he did a little bit of extended education in security management. He had been a security guard for a long time and wanted to start his own man power business. That is, guards and patrols and the like. I had always wanted to do this myself, but there are laws that prevent me from doing this without certain licenses and the people who had those licenses at the time were too scared to go at it alone. It is for this reason I admire this man, because he essentially did what every one else was too scared to do.

The security industry here is poor. Everything is slack and margins are almost non existent. Most people in charge have no idea what they are doing and many have the job just because they were in the job for a long time. The important mantra to know here is: Time in job DOES NOT EQUAL experience.

This security business started with very few people and he had to work with security agencies to get subcontractors as he needed them. The reason you do this is because you do not always know when and where you will need someone. If you can't afford to hire someone full time, you use agencies. They cost more in the long run, but save you a lot in the short term as you do not need to hire them full time and once the job is done they go back to the agency.

This went on for many years. During this time I had another friend who worked for him in the early stages of the business and he advised it was bad. I feel that this person may have had a questionable work ethic, but this wouldn't really matter. All man power security businesses that work almost entirely on contractors, have no culture. Not only no culture, but the employees have no respect or trust for each other, as they do not work with them on the regular basis. It makes for a horrible work environment, no matter what industry you work in.

To compound this, many lower quality security workers can only get work with agencies as most permanent positions are taken by better workers. This is unfortunately a fact. Many of these people are the product of their environment. Many are uneducated, many are looking for a step up from unskilled labour. Many are just big guys with no manners or brains. Many are criminals or drug addicts or pretty much everything you are being hired to protect against. I have met a fair few of these sort of people. Which is why I love how this business turned out.

Recently I met up with the owner for a catchup. In 5 years, he has taken a crap business and turned it into the highest quality man power business in this area. See, he had worked for a crappy sub contracted style company himself a lot and hated it. His goal was to save up as much as possible early on, which included minimum wages and mostly contractor work, to then go out and hire the best people to change the industry. And he did. The industry here and in most places around the world is pretty rubbish. His business is now known as the one that gets things done first time every time. Which, if you think about it, is not a common practice amongst the service industry anymore. Specially for new businesses. He is also now the most expensive. Quality and reputation built from nothing over 5 years and the profit has arrived for him.

Another reason this story resonates with me is because I wanted to do it and every one else around me at the time hated the industry or was scared to go out on their own. You do not need a lot of money to start a service business. You just need determination. Oh, and I suppose knowledge helps. In this case licenses also help. Look, ignore this part. The fact is, the story (if you believe it, which it is, I am just being vague on names and places on purpose) is a perfect example of people not being happy with low quality. If you work for a really bad company and you think you can do better, there is a very high chance you are right. If you have the skills and determination, you most certainly can do better. Just make sure, your business is for people, or you will turn out the same as the other business.
